title: Report: Commanders LB Leo Chenal to have season-ending neck surgery

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Report: Commanders LB Leo Chenal to have season-ending neck surgery
sources.description: Commanders linebacker Leo Chenal was put on a stretcher and carted off the field during Sunday's home win with a neck injury that will reportedly end his season.
